allowed_changes: use exact frozen VBR/MTUM/QUAL/SPLV adjusted-close total-return files
convert all four legs to CNY using the same historical usd_per_cny path before covariance estimation
at first common trading date of each calendar year compute covariance from exactly the preceding 252 common daily CNY returns, excluding execution-day prices
solve exact long-only fully-invested minimum variance by active-set enumeration with nonnegative weights summing to one
rebalance only on the twelve frozen annual schedule dates
matched control is 25% each same four factor legs with annual rebalance
expected_outputs: Factor MinVar, annual equal-factor and cash portfolio CSVs
actual trades, max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance is viewed, do not change covariance lookback, covariance estimator, factor membership, optimizer constraints, rebalance cadence or add a safe asset/timing overlay in this lineage. Any shrinkage/risk-parity/factor-selection architecture is a separately preregistered strategy family, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: EWMA, shrinkage, diagonal loading, covariance blending or regime-specific covariance after results
weight floors, caps, turnover penalties or minimum factor inclusion weights
dropping a zero/low-weight factor or replacing any of VBR/MTUM/QUAL/SPLV
adding TLT, gold, cash, SPY or any fifth sleeve after results
using expected-return forecasts, momentum ranking, trend, macro, VIX or drawdown overlays
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: Value, momentum, quality and low-volatility are distinct long-only equity factor exposures whose realized correlations and volatilities vary through time. Once per year, using only the previous 252 common CNY daily returns to solve the exact fully-invested long-only minimum-variance portfolio across the four frozen factor ETFs may lower tail risk relative to naive equal weighting while retaining a diversified factor return base, without forecasting returns, timing markets, shorting or leverage.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Long-only diversified factor research reports that covariance-aware allocation can improve out-of-sample factor portfolio efficiency, with much of the gain coming through stronger low-volatility diversification rather than return forecasts
This implementation fixes a canonical one-trading-year 252-return covariance window and exact long-only minimum variance before viewing the combined portfolio result
selection_metric: No parameter or asset selection. The factor universe is fixed to VBR/MTUM/QUAL/SPLV; covariance uses exactly the prior 252 common CNY daily returns ending before the execution date; weights are the exact nonnegative sum-to-one minimum-variance solution; rebalance annually. Validation, campaign objective and comparison versus annual 25%-each four-factor control are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.rebalance: first common trading date of each calendar year
